links.outcome: Reproducibility of model diagnoses across three independent runs
links.effect: Reliability substantial for GPT-5 and o3, moderate for Gemini 2.5 Pro and Grok-4, and poor for Claude Opus 4.1.
links.quote: Reliability was substantial for GPT-5 and o3, moderate for Gemini 2.5 Pro and Grok-4, and poor for Claude Opus 4.1.

links.outcome: Frontier model diagnostic accuracy on difficult radiology cases versus radiologists
links.effect: Radiologists 83%, trainees 45%, best AI model (GPT-5) 30%; models fall far short of radiologists on challenging cases.
links.quote: Board-certified radiologists achieved the highest diagnostic accuracy (83%), outperforming trainees (45%) and all AI models (best performance shown by GPT-5: 30%).

links.outcome: Frontier AI diagnostic accuracy compared against radiologists and trainees on same cases
links.effect: Radiologists 83%, trainees 45%, all AI models lower (best GPT-5 30%).
links.quote: Board-certified radiologists achieved the highest diagnostic accuracy (83%), outperforming trainees (45%) and all AI models (best performance shown by GPT-5: 30%).

unlisted_practices: Taxonomy of visual reasoning errors from analysis of AI reasoning traces

screen.reason: The study benchmarks several frontier multimodal LLMs against board-certified radiologists on complex radiology cases and provides an error taxonomy, evaluating model capability rather than testing a specific clinical deployment safeguard.
